newsitem.title: USA: IMF has no comment on news of team leaving Russia.
newsitem.headline: IMF has no comment on news of team leaving Russia.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund had no immediate comment on Thursday on reports that it was pulling its visiting mission from Moscow without reaching a decision on whether to free up additional funds for Russia.
Russia's central bank reported earlier that the mission was leaving Moscow without reaching a decision, but added the IMF team would return in the first half of November for further talks.
"The parties failed to reach a common opinion on a number of problems," the central bank said in a statement.
The IMF monitors Russia's economic performance on a monthly basis under a three-year, $10 billion loan agreement reached last year.
The Fund delayed one tranche of the loan earlier this year because of doubts over Russia's ability to meet budget plans.
